name: X Intelligence
description: Read-only official X source operations with bounded, compliance-aware evidence.

apiKey.label: X Read-only Bearer Token
apiKey.help: Server-side application bearer token for public read-only X operations.

ownedMetricsApiKey.label: X Owned-metrics Credential
ownedMetricsApiKey.help: Separate SecretRef or X_OWNED_METRICS_TOKEN user-context credential for explicitly approved owned-account metrics. Never falls back to X_BEARER_TOKEN.

cacheTtlMinutes.label: X Content Cache TTL
cacheTtlMinutes.help: Mutable content cache lifetime, capped at 24 hours.

complianceRefresh.label: X Content Compliance Refresh
complianceRefresh.help: Bounded native refresh of active cached post/profile IDs. Disabled until developer-use and retention acceptance passes.
